modernTaskFollowup.authoritativeTransform: CAD renderer uses P * B. Base rotations/reflections pivot about descriptor bounds center C, so B(C)=C+baseTranslation. World body center = quaternion(poseRotation).act(C + baseTranslation) + poseTranslation. Translation is not generally body center. Compare pair relative X ordering, not origin sign, array order, contact ID suffix, or lexical ordering.
